text:
eden: Customer on prod reporting intermittent 500s from /v1/generate and a sudden billing spike. They say ~40% errors for a ~30m window. Asked for minimal repro + request IDs so we can trace. acct redwood-corp-241.

sam: I pulled the headers they sent earlier — two clear X-Request-ID values: req-20260301-abc123 and req-20260301-def456. Both within the error window. Logs show 502/500 responses.

eden: thanks @sam. Can eng provide minimal curl + SDK snippets we can send the customer to reproduce quickly? Also need exact log lines we should ask them to attach or a debug bundle command.

aaron: sure — share this minimal curl and tell them to include the X-Request-ID header they see. keep auth via env var, don't paste keys here. :thumbsup:

```bash
# minimal curl repro (replace $REDWOOD_API_KEY and X-Request-ID)
curl -v \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Request-ID: req-20260301-abc123" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v1","input":"Hello world","max_tokens":32}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

aaron: minimal SDK snippets (keep them minimal so customer can run locally). Ask them to run with the same request-id header if possible.

```python
# python (requests-based minimal)
import os
import requests

headers = {
  'Authorization': f"Bearer {os.environ.get('REDWOOD_API_KEY')}",
  'X-Request-ID': 'req-20260301-abc123',
  'Content-Type': 'application/json',
}
resp = requests.post(
  'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate',
  headers=headers,
  json={"model":"redwood-v1","input":"Hello world","max_tokens":32}
)
print(resp.status_code)
print(resp.text)
```

```javascript
// nodejs minimal (fetch/undici)
const fetch = require('node-fetch');
(async () => {
  const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY}`,
      'X-Request-ID': 'req-20260301-abc123',
      'Content-Type': 'application/json'
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'redwood-v1', input: 'Hello world', max_tokens: 32 })
  });
  console.log(res.status, await res.text());
})();
```

```go
// go minimal (net/http)
package main

import (
  "bytes"
  "fmt"
  "net/http"
  "os"
)

func main() {
  body := []byte(`{"model":"redwood-v1","input":"Hello world","max_tokens":32}`)
  req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate", bytes.NewBuffer(body))
  req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
  req.Header.Set("X-Request-ID", "req-20260301-abc123")
  req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
  resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
  if err != nil { panic(err) }
  defer resp.Body.Close()
  fmt.Println("status", resp.StatusCode)
}
```

maya: add this to ask for a debug bundle if the curl reproduces the error or if they hit 500s — it grabs request/trace context on our side.

```bash
# redwood-cli (internal) - customer can run and then send bundle.zip
redwood-cli collect-debug --x-request-id req-20260301-abc123 --output debug-bundle-abc123.zip
```

maya: if they can't run the CLI we can also ask them to paste the exact response headers and the full body (sanitized). Tell them to run the curl with -v so headers show.

infra-bot: Prod deploy rollout roll-789 at ~14:00Z. Recent batcher kernel change was included in that rollout (tag: batcher-optim-v2). Might be relevant.

rachel: billing note — I see a short spike in token usage from that account matching the time window. If repro confirms repeated retries, that could explain the invoice delta. Will open a billing ticket if we confirm.

eden: OK I'm going to send the python/js/go snippets + curl + debug-bundle command to the customer and ask them to run one of the SDK examples, capture -v output or the debug bundle, and attach the X-Request-ID. I'll ask for both request IDs we have (req-20260301-abc123, req-20260301-def456).

sam: if we get the bundle, please assign to me and tag @aaron so we can grep traces for those request IDs and check upstream services.

eden: thanks all — I'll update the ticket when they respond. :eyes:
